2.

Mr Anturkar, learned counsel for the Petitioner, submits that this is the matter where the
Petitioner's property was taken over by the Kalyan Dombivali Municipal Corporation ("Kdmc")
without following the due process of law.

3.  Mr Anturkar refers to the interim order dated 5th January 2023 made in this Petition, where this Court disapproved the action of the KDMC but, because the construction on the Petitioner's property was complete, directed the KDMC to pay the Petitioner 50% of the tentative compensation amount.
4.
The KDMC made a statement before this Court that it would acquire the Petitioner's land in accordance with law.

Consistent with this statement, the KDMC, vide communication dated 01/02/2023, has submitted the acquisition proposal to the Collector of Thane (Land Acquisition Section).
5.
Mr Anturkar submits that the Petitioners have certain grievances about the compensation amount paid to them.

However, without prejudice to such grievances, the Petitioners, for the present, seek a direction to the Collector, Thane (Land Acquisition Section), to proceed with the acquisition proposal submitted by the KDMC and dispose of the same in accordance with law within a timeline that this Court should set out.

6. Mr Dani, a learned senior Advocate appearing for the KDMC, states that the KDMC can have no objection to the Collector disposing of its acquisition proposal in accordance with 12th July 2024 2-ASIWP-4227-2023 IN WP-4024-2021.DOC the law in a time-bound manner.
The learned AGP states that this Court may grant the Collector about six months' time to dispose of the acquisition proceedings.

7. Accordingly, we direct the Collector, Thane (Land Acquisition Section), to dispose of the acquisition proposal submitted by the KDMC as expeditiously as possible and in any event within six months from today, i.e., on or before 10th January 2025.
8. With the above directions and by leaving all contentions of all parties open, we dispose of this Petition.
The interim orders made earlier are made absolute.
9. The petition is disposed of.
There shall be no orders for costs.
10. The pending Interim Application is also disposed of by leaving open all the contentions raised therein.
All concerned to act on an authenticated copy of this order.

(Kamal Khata, J) (M.S. Sonak, J)
